title: The Rapier Primer
summary: A plain primer teaching grip and guard and the straight lunge to an untrained student who has no qi.

title: Lunge and Recover Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of short repeated exercises for the lunge and the return to guard for first-year students.

title: A Handbook of the Narrow Point
summary: Explains how the narrow point is aimed and held steady when the arm is tired and the foe moves.

title: Workbook of the Slim Blade Guards
summary: A workbook of the guard postures of the slim blade taught to students before any qi is stirred.

title: Footwork Before the Point
summary: Teaches the advance and retreat steps that carry the point to the foe and the body out of reach.

title: Plain Rules of the Thrusting Sword
summary: Sets out the plain rules of thrusting with a rapier for bodies that train by sweat alone.

title: Treatise on the Quickened Point
summary: A treatise on carrying a little qi to the point so each thrust lands faster than the eye follows.

title: Cup-Hilt Grip Canon
summary: A canon of the cup-hilt grip showing how a student of the first qi stage steadies a thrusting blade.

title: Primer of Breath and Lunge
summary: A primer that joins each lunge to one breath so the new circulation of qi moves with the arm.

title: The Narrow Line Drill-Book
summary: Drills the student to hold one narrow line toward the foe and thrust along it without the shoulders drifting.

title: Short Course in Thrust Timing
summary: A short course on choosing the instant to thrust against a foe who steps in or stands still.
